description: Defines a generic LRU cache template class with thread safety, including methods for adding, retrieving, erasing, and clearing cache entries, as well as internal data structures and hash/equality functors.
external_methods: std::unordered_map<const K*, typename ElementList::iterator, Hasher, Equaler>

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A thread-safe, templated, LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with configurable maximum size, supporting add, get, erase, and clear operations.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an object to the cache, evicting the least recently used item if the cache exceeds max size.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an object by key, updating its position to the most recently used.

methods.name: GetLatest
methods.description: Returns the most recently added or accessed object in the cache.

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Removes an object from the cache by key.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: Numel
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the cache.
